caption: The drawing features a single piece of furniture, specifically a rectangular table. The tabletop is rendered in a grayish color with visible marble-like veining, indicating a stone or marble surface. The edges of the tabletop are curved and contoured, rather than straight or sharply angled. The base and legs of the table are depicted in a warm brown wood, with a smooth finish and a gentle, curved design. Each of the four legs is cabriole-shaped, meaning they are curved outward and then inward, ending in a slight outward flare at the feet. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige or light tan color, with no additional objects or decorative elements present.
title: Sideboard Table
